title: indigo_agent_scripting: sun_altitude() passes J2000 Sun coordinates to indigo_radec_to_altaz(), which needs coordinates of date
description:
Found 2026-11-19 while measuring indigocat accuracy. indigo_drivers/agent_scripting/indigo_agent_scripting.c:906-908: sun_altitude() takes indigocat_sun_equatorial_coords() (J2000 frame, see indigo_agent_scheduler_sky.c solar_system() which precesses with indigo_eq_of_date()/indigo_precess() for the same reason) and passes it straight to indigo_radec_to_altaz(), which expects coordinates of date. The error is the precession since J2000, about 0.36 deg today, i.e. about 2-2.5 minutes in Sun altitude timing at mid latitudes, affecting the sequencer's wait_until_solar_altitude_below() and every script using sun_altitude().
Owner asked to fix it.
- Reproduce first: a test (unit or integration through the Scripting Agent) comparing sun_altitude() with a reference altitude (e.g. JPL Horizons apparent alt for a fixed site and time, embedded as constants, or the scheduler's own precessed computation) showing the ~0.3 deg error.
- Fix by precessing to the date as the scheduler does (or via an existing INDIGO J2000->JNow helper), minimal change.
- Audit the other places in agent_scripting (and other agents, excluding the off-limits drivers) that pass indigocat solar-system positions to indigo_radec_to_altaz() or similar 'of date' functions without precession; fix the same defect where found and list them in a note.
- Increment DRIVER_VERSION of every fixed driver; update docs only if they state the behaviour.

outcome.summary: Pass. Fix (indigo_agent_scripting.c:906-912) converts indigocat J2000 RA from degrees to hours before indigo_j2k_to_eq(), which expects RA in hours (indigo_align.c:72-79), then passes hours to indigo_radec_to_altaz(); the equinox is indigo_eq_of_date(jd) with jd = UT2JD(now), the same 'now' passed to altaz. Mathematically equivalent to the scheduler's indigo_precess(2000 -> eq_of_date) in indigo_agent_scheduler_sky.c:88-97 and _night.c:42-50. Reference values independently recomputed with Meeus low-precision apparent Sun + GAST (accuracy ~0.01 deg): 15.3814 and 34.6418 vs embedded 15.3778 and 34.6436 - plausible. Tolerance 0.02 deg rejects the reproduced 0.123 deg error and leaves margin for < 1 arcmin indigocat changes. Test time is fixed via -Dtime=scripting_test_time (indigo_test/Makefile:2560). Audit confirmed with git grep of indigocat_ outside indigocat/off-limits: only scheduler (already precessed), scripting (fixed), server stars.json (J2000 JSON, no altaz), star-catalog users. DRIVER_VERSION 0x03000012 -> 0x03000013. git diff --check clean; whitespace and command-1 passed at HEAD 24f4a40c3 (tree 4d063680, matches notes). Non-blocking nit: test comment at test_agent_scripting.c:947 says precession 'moves the result by about 0.3 deg' - it moves RA by ~0.3 deg, the altitude by ~0.12 deg here. Limits: did not rerun the test suite myself; did not query Horizons.

history.text: Fetching JPL Horizons Sun reference altitudes for a synthetic site
Check command-1 started: make Makefile.inc && make init && make -j8 -C indigo_libs all && make -C indigo_test test-agent-scripting
Check command-1 started: make Makefile.inc && make init && make -j8 -C indigo_libs all && make -C indigo_test test-agent-scripting test-agent-scripting-sequencer

Reproduction: new integration case 'solar altitude matches reference' in indigo_test/integration/test_agent_scripting.c calls indigo_solar_altitude() through the Scripting Agent at the suite's existing fixed time override (time() -> 1704112496, 2024-01-01 12:34:56 UTC) and compares with JPL Horizons apparent airless Sun elevation (queried once, synthetic sites 48.15N 17.11E and 30S 70W: 15.377750482 and 34.643634261 deg), tolerance 0.02 deg. On unmodified driver code (flow check command-1, tree 85e74042): FAIL, 'solar altitude 15.254896504203412 instead of 15.377750482' (error 0.123 deg in altitude from ~0.33 deg precession since J2000); 37/38 cases passed.

Fix: indigo_drivers/agent_scripting/indigo_agent_scripting.c solar_altitude() now precesses the indigocat J2000 Sun position to the equinox of date with indigo_j2k_to_eq(indigo_eq_of_date(jd), ...) before indigo_radec_to_altaz(), as the scheduler does. DRIVER_VERSION 0x03000012 -> 0x03000013. No indigocat change; the 0.02 deg tolerance holds before and after ticket 885c8a5b removes nutation/aberration from indigocat_sun_equatorial_coords() (< 1 arcmin). Docs (indigo_docs/mcp/agents/scripting.md 'geometric altitude', Sequencer.md) do not state the frame; no doc change.

Audit: indigocat solar-system positions (indigocat_sun/moon_equatorial_coords*) are used in agent_scheduler/indigo_agent_scheduler_sky.c solar_system() and agent_scheduler/indigo_agent_scheduler_night.c sun_coordinates(), both already precess with indigo_precess(2000 -> indigo_eq_of_date(jd)) - correct. agent_scripting solar_altitude() was the only defective caller (fixed). indigo_server.c uses indigocat_get_ss_data() only to emit J2000 sky-map JSON next to J2000 stars (no alt/az conversion) - not affected. ccd_simulator and agent_platesolver use star catalogs only. Off-limits drivers excluded. Observation, not changed (out of scope): indigo_target_altitude(ra, dec, ...) passes caller-supplied coordinates straight to indigo_radec_to_altaz(), so it expects coordinates of date; Sequencer wait_until_target_altitude_above()/break_if_target_altitude_below() pass user values whose frame is undocumented.

Test mapping: acceptance 'sun_altitude() matches reference within 0.02 deg' -> test_agent_scripting 'solar altitude matches reference' (two sites, northern and southern hemisphere, Horizons apparent airless constants). Existing 'conversion and astronomy bindings' and test_agent_scripting_sequencer cover binding presence and sequencer use. Running via flow check --command: make test-agent-scripting test-agent-scripting-sequencer.

After fix (tree 4d063680): flow check whitespace passed (only configured check selected for these paths); flow check --command 'make Makefile.inc && make init && make -j8 -C indigo_libs all && make -C indigo_test test-agent-scripting test-agent-scripting-sequencer' passed: Scripting Agent 38/38, Sequencer.js 68/68.
